book.name: Aj Galacia
book.title: Tuꞌj Pabl kye Nimil aj Galacia

content: Qmojim qibꞌ qxolx

Ayiꞌy werman, qa at jun kyxola ma kubꞌ tzꞌaq toj il, me ayetzin kyeꞌ, ayiꞌy waꞌlqiꞌy toj kynimbꞌila, kyxkonksa, ex kywaꞌbꞌinkuy juntl majl toj tnimbꞌil. Me chebꞌeku kybꞌinchinkuy, quꞌn yajtzila qa ayekul kyeꞌ ẍi kubꞌ tzꞌaq toj il.
Bꞌaꞌnqexa; kyonim kyibꞌa tuꞌn tikyꞌx yajbꞌil kyuꞌn, quꞌn atzin tumiljo tuꞌn tjapin bꞌajjo Tkawbꞌil Crist kyuꞌn.
Me qa at jun kyeꞌ tkyꞌeꞌ tuꞌn tkubꞌ tbꞌinchiꞌn lo, noq tuꞌn tnimsin tibꞌ, ntiꞌ tajbꞌin ikyjo, ex ax nkubꞌ sbꞌunte tibꞌ.
Qalaꞌ, ax te junjun k-okil tkaꞌyin tibꞌ: Qa wen n-ele toj twutz tzeꞌnku taꞌye, bꞌaꞌn ttzalaj, me nya tuꞌn tok tqꞌoꞌn twutz tiꞌj juntl.
Quꞌn teyilex te junjun k-okil toj paꞌbꞌin twutz Dios, ex nlay tzꞌok tqꞌoꞌn til te tpaj juntl.
Ikytzin kyeꞌ werman, alkye ntzaj kꞌmonte Tyol Dios te jun xnaqꞌtzil, il tiꞌj tuꞌn tkubꞌ tpaꞌn a at te tukꞌa xnaqꞌtzilte.
Mi kubꞌ kysbꞌuꞌn kyibꞌa ayexa. Quꞌn mix aꞌlx te Dios aku kubꞌ sbꞌunte, quꞌn tzeꞌnxjo kbꞌantil tuꞌnxjal, ikyx t-xeljo ktlaꞌbꞌil.

Altzin kye kꞌwel bꞌinchinte jun tiꞌ nya bꞌaꞌn, a tzeꞌnku ntqanin ojtxe tten, ikytzin t-xeljo ktlaꞌbꞌil, ex kkyimil teꞌ te jun majx. Me atzin teꞌ a kꞌwel tbꞌinchin bꞌaꞌn, a tzeꞌnku taj Xewbꞌaj Xjan, ktlaꞌbꞌil tuꞌn Xewbꞌaj Xjan jun tchwinqil te jun majx.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, mi txi qtzaqpiꞌn tuꞌn qbꞌinchin teꞌ wen, tuꞌntzin aj tkanin tqꞌijil chojbꞌil, kqlaꞌbꞌil jun chwinqil te jun majx.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, kukx qo bꞌinchiꞌn bꞌaꞌn qkyaqil kyiꞌj tkyaqil xjal, me nejxix kyiꞌj nimil.
At kolbꞌil qe, nya tuꞌn tok qechil, qalaꞌ noq tuꞌn qitzꞌjlin tkabꞌ majin
Kykaꞌyinkutziꞌn; ayinkuy ma chin kubꞌ tzꞌibꞌiꞌnte luꞌn tukꞌa ma nmaq ntzꞌibꞌiꞌn.

Ayetziꞌn xnaqꞌtzil nchi qꞌmaꞌnte, qa ilxix tiꞌj tuꞌn tel qitit chꞌin kytzꞌumila te kyechila. Nkyqꞌmaꞌn ikyjo, noq tuꞌn kyel wen kywutzxjal, ex noq tuꞌn mi chi el ikyꞌine, tuꞌn tpajjo xnaqꞌtzbꞌil lo: Qa nya tuꞌn qbꞌinchbꞌin at kolbꞌil qe te jun majx, qalaꞌ noq tiꞌj Crist, a kyim twutz cruz te qxel.

Me ayetzin xjal luꞌn, a kyaj tuꞌn tok kyechila tiꞌj kychibꞌjila, me mi njapin tkyaqil ojtxe kawbꞌil kyuꞌn. Oꞌkxnaj kyajjo tuꞌn tok kyeꞌ kyechil, noq tuꞌn tjaw kynimsin kyibꞌ, qa noq tuꞌn kytzi nkubꞌ kybꞌinchinjiꞌy a nkyqꞌmaꞌn.

Me metzin weꞌ, nkyꞌeꞌy tuꞌn tjaw nnimsin wibꞌa. Qalaꞌ, noq tuꞌn nnimsiꞌn tkyimlin qAjaw Jesucrist twutz cruz. Quꞌn tkyaqiljo at twutz txꞌotxꞌ, a kyaj txqantl xjal, ntiꞌl waja tiꞌj, quꞌn nyakuj kyimnin taꞌye toj nwutza, ex nyakuj kyimninqiꞌn toj twutz.
Ikytziꞌn luꞌn: Ex qa at qechil tok, ex qa mina, me qa at qnimbꞌil tiꞌj Crist, a Jesús, o qo itzꞌje tkabꞌ majin tuꞌn qnimbꞌil tiꞌj.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, tkyaqiljo nbꞌet tzeꞌnku xnaqꞌtzbꞌil lo, a twutzxix Ttanim qMan Dios. Axit Dios kubꞌ kyꞌiwlin kyeꞌy tukꞌa jun nukꞌbꞌil ex tukꞌa tqꞌaqꞌbꞌil tkꞌuꞌj.
Atzin jaꞌlin, mix aꞌl jun tuꞌn tjaw yolbꞌin wiꞌja, quꞌn nimx weꞌ wechil ma tzꞌok tuꞌn ẍin bꞌaj kyjubꞌchiꞌn xjal, noq tuꞌn ẍinx lipeꞌy tiꞌj Jesús.
Ayiꞌy werman, axit qAjaw Jesucrist qꞌonte t-xtalbꞌil tojile kyanmiꞌn kykyaqilxa. Ikyxitjo.
